messages.author: 74e593af5a12c198
messages.subject: Unable to Load Data
parts:
Hello!

 

I am currently attempting to load WGBS data to methylkit via HPC cluster with little success. I call an R file using a batch script running for 300 hours. Right now, the program runs without creating an output in the flat database. I wanted verify if the following code is incorrect or not.

 

library(methylKit)

 

file.list_TERT=list(data.table::fread("/lustre/groups/chiappinellilab/processed_data/Uzma/WGBS_bj_fibroblast_project/methylkit/cov_files/EP_1_SH5850_SA46160_S31_L004_R1_001_bismark_bt2_pe.deduplicated.sam.bismark.cov.gz"),

                    data.table::fread("/lustre/groups/chiappinellilab/processed_data/Uzma/WGBS_bj_fibroblast_project/methylkit/cov_files/EP_2_SH5851_SA46161_S32_L004_R1_001_bismark_bt2_pe.deduplicated.sam.bismark.cov.gz"),

                    data.table::fread("/lustre/groups/chiappinellilab/processed_data/Uzma/WGBS_bj_fibroblast_project/methylkit/cov_files/EP_2_SH5851_SA46161_S32_L008_R1_001_bismark_bt2_pe.deduplicated.sam.bismark.cov.gz"),

                    data.table::fread("/lustre/groups/chiappinellilab/processed_data/Uzma/WGBS_bj_fibroblast_project/methylkit/cov_files/TERT_1_SH5853_SA46162_S33_L005_R1_001_bismark_bt2_pe.deduplicated.sam.bismark.cov.gz"),

                    data.table::fread("/lustre/groups/chiappinellilab/processed_data/Uzma/WGBS_bj_fibroblast_project/methylkit/cov_files/TERT_1_SH5853_SA46162_S33_L008_R1_001_bismark_bt2_pe.deduplicated.sam.bismark.cov.gz")

)

 

myobjDB_TERT=methRead(file.list_TERT,

                      sample.id=list("EP_1", "EP_2_1", "EP_2_1", "TERT_1", "TERT_2"),

                      assembly="hg38",

                      pipeline="bismarkCoverage",

                      treatment=c(0,0,0,1,1),

                      context="CpG",

                      dbtype = "tabix",

                      dbdir = "methylDB"

)

 

Thank you!

messages.author: a413e6cf6c4ea2cc
messages.subject: Re: Unable to Load Data
parts:
Hi uzma,

This is not the correct way to load your data into methylKit. The methRead function expects file paths to the input files, but you are providing the data itself. 
Please omit the call to data.table::fread and you should be good to go. 

Best,
Alex
